piece:
Swap the leads

Two lead sheets in a jar of acid on my six clay pots, formed the way Planté did it. When a plate's layer is full, every bit of current goes into bubbles; when I swap the leads the jar goes quiet while the current eats back into the lead, until it is full again and fizzes. Left on one way for six hours they hold nothing at all, swapped every hour they hold a quarter of an amp-hour, and next I swap them by hand and put the cart on them.
